69803-australia-fortune-land.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. So for fifty years she had dumped her convicts there--some cut-throats of the lowest type, others misguided idealists who had queer political views. As a result about one-half of the population of Australia were either convicts or “emancipists”--the latter, convicts who had served their terms but were not permitted to return to the motherland.

arxiv-1806-05456.title: Checking the Salpeter enhancement of nuclear reactions in asymmetric mixtures
arxiv-1806-05456.creator: Jean Clérouin, Philippe Arnault, and Nicolas Desbiens, Alexander J. White, Lee A. Collins, Joel D. Kress, and Christopher Ticknor
arxiv-1806-05456.description: Abstract We investigate the plasma enhancement of nuclear reactions in the intermediate coupling regime using orbital free molecular dynamics (OFMD) simulations. Mixtures of H-Cu and H-Ag serve as prototypes of simultaneous weak and strong couplings due to the charge asymmetry. Of particular importance is the partial ionization of Cu and Ag and the free electron polarization captured by OFMD simulations.

arxiv-2208-10680.title: Projective splitting with backward, half-forward and proximal-Newton steps
arxiv-2208-10680.creator: M. Marques Alves
arxiv-2208-10680.description: Abstract We propose and study the weak convergence of a projective splitting algorithm [ 2 , 30 ] for solving multi-term composite monotone inclusion problems involving the finite sum of n n maximal monotone operators, each of which having an inner four-block structure: sum of maximal monotone, Lipschitz continuous, cocoercive and smooth differentiable operators.

arxiv-2307-11371.title: Random Separating Hyperplane Theorem and Learning Polytopes
arxiv-2307-11371.creator: Chiranjib Bhattacharyya, Ravindran Kannan, Amit Kumar
arxiv-2307-11371.description: Abstract The Separating Hyperplane theorem is a fundamental result in Convex Geometry with myriad applications. The theorem asserts that for a point a a not in a closed convex set K K , there is a hyperplane with K K on one side and a a strictly on the other side.

arxiv-2308-12522.title: Uniformly Distributed Category Prototype-Guided Vision-Language Framework for Long-Tail Recognition Conference: Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 29-November 3, 2023; Ottawa, ON, Canada Proceedings of the 31st ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’
arxiv-2308-12522.creator: Siming Fu, Xiaoxuan He, Xinpeng Ding, Yuchen Cao, Hualiang Wang
arxiv-2308-12522.description: Abstract . Recently, large-scale pre-trained vision-language models have presented benefits for alleviating class imbalance in long-tailed recognition. However, the long-tailed data distribution can corrupt the representation space, where the distance between head and tail categories is much larger than the distance between two tail categories.

arxiv-2312-08898.title: Detection and Defense of Unlearnable Examples
arxiv-2312-08898.creator: Yifan Zhu, Lijia Yu, Xiao-Shan Gao
arxiv-2312-08898.description: Abstract Privacy preserving has become increasingly critical with the emergence of social media. Unlearnable examples have been proposed to avoid leaking personal information on the Internet by degrading generalization abilities of deep learning models. However, our study reveals that unlearnable examples are easily detectable.

arxiv-2402-17685.description: Abstract Attosecond photoemission or photoionization delays are a unique probe of the structure and the electronic dynamics of matter. pmc-10672525.description: Head and neck squamous cell cancer (HNSCC) is one of the ten most common malignant neoplasms, characterized by an aggressive course, high recurrence rate, poor response to treatment, and low survival rate. pmc-11484736.title: Molecular subtypes and prognostic factors of lung large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma
pmc-11484736.creator: Tingting Liu, Xueyuan Chen, Silang Mo, Ting Zhou, Wenjuan Ma, Gang Chen, Xiang Chen, Mengting Shi, Yuwen Yang, Yan Huang, Hongyun Zhao, Wenfeng Fang, Yunpeng Yang, Jing Li, Li Zhang, Yuanyuan Zhao
pmc-11484736.description: BackgroundLung large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC) is an aggressive disease with poor prognosis and short-term survival, which lacks effective prognostic indicators. The study aims to investigate the molecular subtypes and prognostic markers of lung LCNEC.MethodsPatients diagnosed with lung LCNEC at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC) between November 2007 and January 2021 were screened.

pmc-11591984.title: Research Advances in Adenomyosis-Related Signaling Pathways and Promising Targets
pmc-11591984.creator: Hongyu Zhang, Chaoming Li, Wenyan Li, Wenhu Xin, Tiansheng Qin
pmc-11591984.description: Adenomyosis is a benign gynecological condition characterized by the proliferation of the endometrial stroma and glands into the myometrium, uterine volume enlargement, and peripheral smooth muscle hypertrophy. The typical clinical symptoms include chronic pelvic pain, abnormal uterine bleeding, and subfertility, all of which significantly impact quality of life.

pmc-11617565.title: Mendelian randomization and bioinformatics unveil potential links between gut microbial genera and colorectal cancer
pmc-11617565.creator: Long Wu, Huan Wu, Fei Huang, Song Mu, Xiao-Yun Li, Bao-Fang Zhang, Yun-Huan Zhen, Hai-Yang Li
pmc-11617565.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) poses a significant global health burden, with high incidence and mortality rates. Despite advances in diagnostic and therapeutic modalities, early diagnosis remains critical for improved outcomes. Recent research has realized the important role of gut microbiota in CRC development, highlighting the need to elucidate potential relationships.

pmc-12455966.title: Parallel evolution of the elite neutralizer phenotype in divergent HIV-1 clades
pmc-12455966.creator: Kathryn A. Mesa, Sophia W. Li, Jennie M. Hutchinson, Sara O'Rourke, David L. Alexander, Bin Yu, Xiaoying Shen, Terri Wrin, Christos J. Petropoulos, Phillip W. Berman, Grant H. Pogson
pmc-12455966.description: The development of an effective vaccine against HIV-1 requires understanding how broadly neutralizing antibodies (bNAbs) evolve in natural viral infections. Here, we recovered 152 envelope sequences from two elite neutralizers (ENs) and five viral controllers and determined the neutralization sensitivity (IC50) of each envelope glycoprotein (Env) to broadly neutralizing monoclonal antibodies (bN-mAbs).

pmc-12931149.title: Remdesivir in COVID‐19: A Focus on Pediatric Cardiac Patients
pmc-12931149.creator: Dima Bsat, Dalia Safi, Mariam Arabi, Mamunur Rahman Malik
pmc-12931149.description: The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID‐19) pandemic has presented a significant global health challenge that necessitated the immediate search for various therapeutic modalities. Remdesivir, an antiviral drug inhibiting RNA‐dependent RNA polymerase (RdRp), was among the most heavily used drugs against COVID‐19. Of the several randomized controlled trials studying the efficacy of remdesivir, the vast majority were studied on the adult population.
